snippet.title: Repterra – Official Announcement Trailer | Dinosaur Survival RTS
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2768380/Repterra/
🦖 Repterra is now officially published by MicroProse.

In this large-scale survival RTS set in a world overrun by dinosaurs, you’ll rebuild humanity’s foothold from the ruins. Construct colonies, establish production lines, defend against relentless hordes, and turn prehistoric predators into your greatest weapon.

Key Features:
🦖 Breed, tame, and ride dinosaurs
⚔️ Massive battles with 100,000+ creatures on screen
🏹 Three unique factions
🧬 Hero customisation and genetic mutations
🔓 Meta progression with permanent unlocks

🎮 The demo is available NOW on Steam.
⭐ Play the demo and wishlist Repterra today.
